name: integrate
definition: Connect separate modules or services into one coherent system through explicit contracts, validated boundaries, and observable runtime behavior.
operator_form: input_modules + interface_contracts + validation_gates -> integration_operation -> coherent_system + evidence_bundle + rollback_path
acceptance_gates: No service without an owner interface.
No integration without at least one smoke command.
failure_modes: Components are colocated but not integrated.
Module import path works only locally.
next_target: Bind CLI command -> service function -> schema contract -> evidence artifact -> verdict file.
evidence_policy: Remain S0_REPO_FACT plus S5_PROXY until validation commands run and evidence is persisted.
